clauses.text: A claim must be received within 90 days of the date of service.
A corrected claim must be received within 60 days of the remittance date of the original decision.

The filing limit is extended only where: (a) coverage was added retroactively, in which case the claim must be received within 90 days of the date the provider was notified; (b) another payer was primary, in which case the claim must be received within 60 days of the date on the primary payer's explanation of benefits; or (c) the delay was caused by the plan, as shown by plan correspondence.

The plan accepts as proof of timely filing only an acceptance report from the plan or a clearinghouse that shows the claim was accepted by the plan within the limit. Records from the provider's own billing system are not accepted.
Where no exception in clause QUIL-TF-2.1 applies and there is no proof under clause QUIL-TF-2.2, a denial with reason code 29 is final. The member may not be billed.
